panels.title: Record requests per second (gateway)
panels.description: Requests to POST /cabber/location by outcome, as the gateway answered them. Nothing limits the frequency of a cabber, so this is the line to compare with the 200 rps the plan assumes (peak 600).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total{operation="record_location"}[1m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[1m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[1m]) >= 4))

panels.title: Non-success share (gateway)
panels.description: Every answer that is not a success: a rejected body, a refused access, an unavailable dependency. A rise in unavailable is the signal that the storage or a service cannot keep up with an unlimited client.

targets.expr: sum(rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total{operation="record_location",outcome!="success"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) >= 4)) / sum(rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total{operation="record_location"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) >= 4))

panels.title: p95 of recording (location)
panels.description: The target is 300 ms at 200 rps. Time inside the location service only; the calls the gateway makes are on the next panel.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(cabby_location_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="location"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="location"}[5m]) >= 4)))

panels.title: Calls behind the gateway, p95 by service
panels.description: How long the gateway waits for auth (verify_session) and for location (record_location): the share of each service in the time of a record.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) (rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket{operation=~"verify_session|record_location"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) >= 4)))

panels.title: Stored records per hour (growth of the table)
panels.description: Inserts that were committed, extrapolated to an hour. Records are never deleted in v1 and keep growing, so this is the line the retention decision of the plan is made from (about 17 million rows a day at 200 rps).
